summary: Sports Entertainment Gaming Global Corp filed an 8-K disclosing a $3.5M convertible promissory note issuance to Amorua Global, Inc. The note carries 12% interest, has a 15% original issue discount, and matures in 24 months. Conversion price is the lower of the closing price on issuance or 95% of the 5-day VWAP, subject to a 9.99% beneficial ownership cap. Proceeds mainly go to general corporate purposes and repaying a $500K note. This is a routine financing, not a special-situations event.
